how to verify this page

every number above was parsed from the sealed record and cross-checked at build time (kernel sha ✓ qthe.mjs · 6/6 verdicts ✓ fleet-seeds scoreboard · 6/6 tips ✓ pinned tip files · 16/16 chain pins recomputed from disk · budget accounts ✓ their lists). re-derive it yourself, from a fresh clone:

node scripts/falsification_budget.mjs    # regenerate the falsification-budget ledger from the sealed record

then rebuild this page: node scripts/build_dashboard.mjs — deterministic, byte-identical on rerun.
